learning_outcomes.text: Be able to compute basic nuclear physics (radiation, nuclear stability, radioactive radiation, nuclear reactions).
Be able to perform basic thermal-hydraulic calculations on nuclear reactors.
Be able to perform basic nuclear fuel cycle calculations.
Be able to analyze nuclear reactor accidents.
Identify, formulate and solve nuclear engineering problems

syllabus_topics: Nuclear Engineering description, basics of thermodynamic cycles.
Reactor Licensing, Safety, and The Environment
Nuclear Reactor Accidents and Passive Nuclear Safety
bibliography: J.J. Duderstadt and L.J. Hamilton, Nuclear Reactor Analysis", John Wiley, 1976.
N.E. Todreas and M.S. Kazimi, Nuclear System I: Thermal Hydraulic Fundamentals, Hemisphere Publishing Corp., 1990.
J. R. Lamarsh, A. J. Baratta, Introduction to Nuclear Engineering, 3d ed., Prentice-Hall, 2001
